AccessKeyId.description: AWS access key ID for authentication; if omitted, IAM role credentials will be used.

SecretAccessKey.description: AWS secret access key for authentication; if omitted, IAM role credentials will be used.

Region.description: AWS region where the S3 bucket is hosted; required if not using IAM roles and no Endpoint is set.

Endpoint.description: Custom S3-compatible endpoint (e.g., for DigitalOcean Spaces); if set, Region is ignored.

PathStyle.description: Use path-style URLs (e.g., /bucket/key) instead of virtual-hosted-style (bucket.s3.region.amazonaws.com/key). Required for certain S3-compatible services.
